modules.name: BMS and EPMS controls

modules.name: L1 / L2: factory witness and installation verification
modules.desc: Level 1 witnessed factory acceptance tests of the major equipment, and Level 2 receiving inspection and installation verification before energization.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: L3: start-up and pre-functional
modules.desc: Level 3: first controlled energization and start-up of each component with the vendor, rotation and point checks, and the pre-functional check sheets.

tasks.desc: Energization plan and lockout / tagout set-up
Pre-functional check sheets and issues log

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: L4: functional performance testing
modules.desc: Level 4: scripted tests of each system to the sequence of operations under load: UPS modes and bypass, generator auto-start and load pickup, transfer switches, chiller and pump lead / lag and failover, CRAH and CDU response, alarms.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: L5: integrated systems test (IST)
modules.desc: Level 5: the facility tested as one at design load on load banks: utility failure with UPS ride-through, generator start and retransfer, single-component failures, maintenance-mode scenarios and fire alarm response.
